jcr:title: Intravascular imaging
jcr:description: At SSS, we provide reprocessed intravascular imaging devices designed to support coronary and peripheral vessel evaluation in catheterization labs. Our portfolio includes four SKUs of Reprocessed Philips IVUS Catheters.
cq:name: intravascular-imaging

sectionTitle.description: EP catheters record and pace electrical cardiogram (ECG) signals within the heart. Catheters utilize electrodes typically constructed of platinum-iridium to receive and transmit electrical signals to the heart. EP catheters can primarily be found in EP and Cath labs.
sectionTitle.title: Proven performance and reliability

text_1853064107.text:
These devices are designed for use in the evaluation of vascular morphology in blood vessels of the coronary and peripheral vasculature by providing a cross-sectional image of such vessels.1

Note: This device is not currently indicated for use in cerebral vessels.2,3
